title: The realm's stated scale - 'the straight road to Marrowgate runs near three hundred turns; a hold seen whole is forty to seventy more, and seeing them all, many times that' - is disclosed only once, buried inside the dense Act 2 status paragraph, never restated or flagged at Act 1's start when a player first commits to the 'see everything' approach.
